title: Attribute-Enhanced Similarity Ranking for Sparse Link Prediction

problem.claim: Link prediction requires predicting missing or future links between random pairs of disconnected nodes.

gap.claim: Performance reported for GNN link-prediction methods in balanced settings does not translate to realistic imbalanced settings, where simpler topology-based approaches may handle sparsity better.

contributions.claim: Gelato is a similarity-based link-prediction method that enhances a topological heuristic with graph learning based on node attributes.
Gelato uses a ranking loss to address class imbalance and a graph-partitioning-based negative-sampling scheme to select hard training pairs efficiently.

author_reported_evidence.claim: In experiments, Gelato is reported to exceed existing GNN-based alternatives.

narrative_sequence.summary: Link prediction concerns missing or future links between disconnected node pairs.
GNN-based methods frame link prediction as binary classification and use balanced sampling to address sparse graphs.
Balanced evaluation results do not carry over to realistic imbalanced settings, and topology-based methods can be better at handling sparsity.
Gelato combines attribute-based graph learning, ranking loss, and hard negative sampling through graph partitioning.
The authors report that Gelato outperforms existing GNN-based alternatives.

source_observation.claim: Balanced sampling for training and evaluation can produce link-prediction performance that does not translate to realistic imbalanced settings.

interpretation.claim: Evaluation distributions should reflect the deployment setting when class sparsity is central to the task.

application.claim: For sparse link prediction, compare methods under imbalanced evaluation and include topology-based baselines.

exception.claim: The abstract does not specify when balanced evaluation may remain appropriate.

unknowns: Dataset identities, sizes, and domain coverage are unspecified.
Experimental protocol, metrics, baselines, and statistical details are unspecified.
The relative contribution of Gelato's individual components is unspecified.
